name: PII Compliance Check MCP
description: Compliance check for PII in documents and images

paragraphs: Compliance MCP is an application built with Gradio designed to perform comprehensive compliance checks and anonymize personally identifiable information (PII) within documents. The application helps businesses comply with major regulatory frameworks like HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA by identifying and anonymizing sensitive data.
features: PII Detection: Identifies sensitive information such as names, social security numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, medical records, and credit card numbers.
Automated Redaction: Automatically redacts detected sensitive information from text documents, images, and PDFs.
